title: Exact formula on upper box dimension of generic Hölder level sets
summary: In the previous decades, the size of level sets of functions have been extensively studied in various setups involving different regularity properties and size notions. In the case of Hölder functions, the authors have provided various bounds, but to date no explicit formulae have been found for any studied dimension and the results were valid only about very specific fractals.
